description_en: Queries the actual SCIM receiving configuration, the expected AC synchronization switch, and the status of the most recent independent SCIM task. Prior SAML configuration is not required
description_zh: 查询 SCIM 实际接收配置、AC 同步期望开关和最近一次独立 SCIM 任务状态。无需先配置 SAML
name: GetIdentityProviderSCIM

parameters.help_en: Required. The ID of the target workspace. The request region must be the same as the region of the target workspace
parameters.help_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

code.description_en: The business result code. Use this code along with the HTTP status code and message for error handling
code.description_zh: 失败时结合 HTTP 状态及 message 处理

data.description_en: The SCIM actual configuration, expected synchronization switch, and independent operation status. For the result structure, see the response fields of this operation. The response of an asynchronous write operation indicates that the request is accepted, but does not guarantee that the background task is complete
data.description_zh: 结果结构见本接口返回字段；异步写接口的返回表示受理，不保证后台任务已完成

configuration.description_en: The actual receiving status and URL. The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only in GetIdentityProvider. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual receiving status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

baseUrl.description_en: The URL configured for the external provisioning system. The presence of a URL does not indicate that external configuration is complete or that AC synchronization is enabled
baseUrl.description_zh: 配置给外部预配系统的 URL；有地址不代表已完成外部配置或开启 AC 同步
baseUrl.title_en: IdP 配置使用的 SCIM 地址
baseUrl.title_zh: IdP 配置使用的 SCIM 地址

status.description_en: The AgentIdentity receiving status. Enabled indicates that SCIM receiving is enabled. Disabled indicates that it is disabled. This is not equivalent to the expected value of syncEnabled for AC
status.description_zh: Enabled 表示已开启 SCIM 接收，Disabled 表示关闭；不等同 AC 的 syncEnabled 期望值

configuration.title_en: 上游实际接收状态及 URL
configuration.title_zh: 上游实际接收状态及 URL

operationStatus.description_en:
The status of the most recent SCIM operation task. This status is independent of the SAML logon binding status. Valid values:
PENDING: Waiting for execution.
RUNNING: Executing.
PAUSED: Paused.
SUCCESS: Succeeded.
FAILED: Failed.
CANCELED: Canceled.
If there are no tasks, it returns null or is not returned. This status only represents the most recent SCIM switch and the initial full import task when enabled. It does not indicate credential issuance, external provisioning connection tests, or continuous incremental synchronization health. Clients poll this operation when the status is PENDING or RUNNING
operationStatus.description_zh: 与 SAML 登录绑定状态独立。PENDING：等待执行；RUNNING：执行中；PAUSED：暂停；SUCCESS：成功；FAILED：失败；CANCELED：取消。尚无任务时为 null 或不返回。仅表示最近一次 SCIM 开关及开启时首次全量导入任务，不表示凭据签发、外部预配连接测试或持续增量同步健康。客户端在 PENDING、RUNNING 时轮询本接口
operationStatus.title_en: 最近一次 SCIM 操作任务状态
operationStatus.title_zh: 最近一次 SCIM 操作任务状态

status.description_en:
The independent SCIM configuration status. Valid values:
UNCONFIGURED: Preparation is not complete.
WAITING_CONFIGURATION: Receiving is enabled, a valid HTTPS URL and at least one valid token are available, waiting for external configuration and enablement confirmation.
UPDATING: The enablement or disablement task is PENDING or RUNNING.
READY: Synchronization is enabled and the current enablement task succeeded, and the receiving end, URL, and token are still available.
DISABLED: The disablement task succeeded, and the configuration, credentials, and users are retained.
UPDATE_FAILED: The operation failed, was paused, was canceled, or the configuration and credentials are unavailable when enablement is expected.
This status is independent of the SAML or OIDC status. READY does not prove that Matrix execution or the continuous incremental link has been accepted
status.description_zh: UNCONFIGURED：尚未准备完成；WAITING_CONFIGURATION：接收 Enabled、有效 HTTPS URL 和至少一个有效 Token 均已具备，等待外部配置并确认启用；UPDATING：启用或停用任务 PENDING/RUNNING；READY：同步已启用且本次启用任务成功，接收、URL 和 Token 仍可用；DISABLED：停用任务成功，保留配置、凭据和用户；UPDATE_FAILED：操作失败、暂停、取消，或期望启用时配置／凭据不可用。与 SAML/OIDC 状态独立，READY 不证明 Matrix 执行或持续增量链路已验收

syncEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether local synchronization is expected. You must determine whether it takes effect based on the actual configuration and task records. Do not set this parameter to true during CustomSSO initialization. You can only update it later by calling UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM, and determine the result based on operationStatus
syncEnabled.description_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；后续只能通过 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 更新，结果结合 operationStatus 判断
syncEnabled.title_en: 本地期望同步开关；需结合实际配置与任务记录判断生效
syncEnabled.title_zh: 本地期望同步开关；需结合实际配置与任务记录判断生效

data.title_en: SCIM 实际配置、期望同步开关及独立操作状态
data.title_zh: SCIM 实际配置、期望同步开关及独立操作状态

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the current request. This code indicates the processing status of the request and is not equivalent to the final result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的处理状态，不等同后台任务最终结果

message.description_en: Task result message. It indicates that the request is accepted or provides an error message. For asynchronous tasks, you must check task results by calling the corresponding query operation
message.description_zh: 请求受理或错误消息；异步任务结果需按对应查询接口核对

requestId.description_en: The request ID. It is used to associate the current call with troubleshooting. Retain this ID when a failure occurs
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次调用与排障，失败时请保留

success.description_en: Indicates whether the current request is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. For asynchronous write operations, you must continue to query the task results
success.description_zh: true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步写入仍需继续查询任务结果
